purpose: Read-only historical formatting metadata plus explicit user formatting overrides. This is not a source of proposal facts. Project prose, personal fields, image bytes and relationship targets have been omitted.
authority: Portable formatting profile. Current user instructions and their designated reference documents take precedence. When using the bundled profile, apply user_overrides over historical role samples. Source DOCX files are private and not bundled; their hashes identify historical samples only.

units.lineRule_auto: line value in 240ths of one line (360 = 1.5 lines)

inheritance_notes: Resolve docDefaults, table-style basedOn chain, paragraph-style basedOn chain, character styles, direct formatting. Use the nearest effective font-slot declaration. A missing run font or size does not mean default or unknown.
For these references the default paragraph style is a (Normal): eastAsia 方正仿宋_GBK, ascii/hAnsi Times New Roman, sz 28. Table styles 26/112 have no conditional branches.
pPr/rPr formats the paragraph mark and is not a substitute for resolving each actual text run. bCs is complex-script bold and is not evidence of Chinese/Latin bold.

When firstLineChars or other character-based indents coexist with twip indents, preserve both and treat character-based values as the relevant character setting; never describe only the twip value as the source setting.
Do not normalize all local roles: cover, tables, body, notes, heading variants and captions have deliberately or historically distinct settings.

user_overrides.authority: Maintainer-confirmed package defaults, 2026-10-04; not a remeasurement of source DOCX. Current users may supply different explicit requirements or reference documents.
user_overrides.effective_resolution: Resolve the historical role formatting from documents, then overlay matching rules below on only the named paragraph properties. Retain existing before/after twip fallbacks when overridden by explicit beforeLines/afterLines. The merged result is the current effective application format; documents.*.role_samples[*].effective_paragraph remains historical source data.
user_overrides.matching_policy: Match document id and semantic paragraph role in the current target. Recorded source locators are reference-version hints, not instructions to edit those numeric paragraph indices blindly. Do not modify shared paragraph styles to apply local overrides.
